description: A directive binds `'[tabindex]': 'order()'` over `order()` returning `0`, and a component of another file extends it under an imported alias, `PctAvatarBase as PctBase`, with `order()` returning `5`, and 2.4.3 keeps resting on the scan. Angular evaluates the inherited binding on the subclass's instance: a value read off a class another class extends is one the reading cannot judge. The alias is read back to the name it imports.
